experiments.hypothesis: Controller-generated neighbor batch=4 in the batch-size family selected by Pi. Test whether it retains serial gains while avoiding the observed batch1 six-way queuing tradeoff.
experiments.notes: Attribution: genuine Pi selected batch-size 16->1; controller fixed the additional 4/8 grid before either neighbor result. No new model call. This scripted queue is a hybrid-planner replay, not two Pi-selected values. Each generated Dockerfile uses the immutable baseline; queue replay changes only this same knob in current last-good context. Replay-v2 correction: generic current-last-good replay may start at batch1 or batch16. Actual measured mixed-round control remains fresh canonical batch16. Policy, candidate bytes, controller attribution and fixed 4/8 values are unchanged.
